description: Re-open a paused (draft) offer so its checkout link takes real money again — the last gate before an offer sells, so confirm with the seller first. REFUSED with 'delivery_required' if the offer would take money and deliver nothing: relay that message rather than retrying, set delivery on the product (update_product delivery_url or delivery_note) or add an order.paid webhook, then call this again. An archived offer must be restored before it can be resumed. Read the response `warnings` too — the gate covers the main product, so a bump or funnel step with no delivery still warns here. Requires an admin (or owner) key.
name: resume_offer
title: Set an offer live
